data.name: Reborn by Fire
data.detailed_description:
Reborn by Fire is an action RPG with strong Souls-like influences, set in a vast dark fantasy world on the brink of collapse. You play as Ignis, a former slave scarred by both physical wounds and deep trauma, on a relentless quest for vengeance against a greedy and manipulative psychopath. As you confront the horrors of a corrupted world, Ignis must also stop the rebirth of an ancient demonic entity that threatens to consume everything.

Don’t wait—add Reborn by Fire to your wishlist today!

Features:

▪ Over 6 interconnected areas in a dark world, full of secrets, shortcuts, and hidden dangers.

▪ Morally dynamic narrative, where your choices shape the fate of Ignis and those around him.

▪ Tactical and brutal combat, where every mistake can be fatal and every victory is hard-won.

▪ Challenging bosses with unpredictable mechanics that test your skill and combat reading.

▪ Deep progression system with abilities that adapt to your playstyle.

▪ Rewarding exploration with secrets, rare items, and story fragments scattered throughout the world.

▪ Immersive soundtrack that intensifies the loneliness, despair, and grandeur of the journey.

▪ Dense Dark Fantasy setting, inspired by tragedy, suffering, and overcoming adversity.

▪ Don't waste time — face the fire, confront your past, and rise from the ashes.
